annotations.title: Polyglot SQL Dialect Transpiler (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite)

description: Transpiles SQL queries and DDL schemas across PostgreSQL, MySQL, and SQLite dialects, rewriting functions and syntax quirks. Use when migrating application queries across database backends or testing against in-memory SQLite; for generating new queries from natural language, use synthesize_sql_query instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'sql_code' and 'source_dialect' ('target_dialect' defaults to 'sqlite'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (10 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

source_dialect.description: Original SQL dialect of the input code: postgresql, mysql, or sqlite.

sql_code.description: SQL query or DDL statement to convert from source dialect into target dialect.

target_dialect.description: Destination SQL dialect to transpile into: postgresql, mysql, or sqlite.

name: transpile_sql_dialect

outputSchema.description: Deterministic execution response schema for transpile_sql_dialect.

compatibility_warnings.description: Potential semantic differences or unsupported features flagged during transpilation.

syntax_transformations.description: List of dialect-specific transformations applied (e.g., NOW() to CURRENT_TIMESTAMP).

transpiled_sql.description: Transpiled SQL code compliant with the target database dialect specification.

title: Polyglot SQL Dialect Transpiler (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite)
